Maulik Shah

BMS (Hons) student, St. Xavier's College, Kolkata

I was born and raised in Kolkata, and I move between English, Hindi, Gujarati and Bengali without thinking twice. This city is home in every sense.

Geography is my quiet obsession. I remember the names and flags of nations from all over the world, and I enjoy any excuse to talk about maps and faraway places.

Thank you for taking the time to read this page.

What I like

Business and strategy

I enjoy business strategy and the puzzle of working out why one idea succeeds and a similar one fails. Case competitions are my favourite way to test that, and winning a national one this year was a big moment for me.

I like entrepreneurship for the same reason: someone sees a gap and builds something to fill it.

Here are slides from two case studies I have worked on. Tap a slide to enlarge it.

Speaking and debate

I like public speaking, and I am happiest when I am talking to a room full of people and can tell they are listening. I also enjoy debating.

Music

I play the keyboard and synthesizer, which I have studied formally for a few years. It is a good break from numbers.

What matters to me

Social work matters a lot to me. I have spent days with children from underprivileged backgrounds, doing activities, learning together and handing out learning kits, and I have raised money for programmes that support senior citizens. Those days taught me more about patience and listening than any classroom has.

I am also curious about how people think. I like hearing from those whose lives look very different from mine, because their ideas change how I see ordinary things.
